answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted sortition: each epoch, a random committee of attestors is drawn, with selection odds proportional to locked stake, not identity count. A puppeteer spawning a hundred shells still holds one purse, so its committee share never grows; it only spreads the same collateral thinner while every shell adds slashing risk. Each sampled attestation is a signal crossing a bridge of randomly drawn peers into the harbor of final consensus, and faking that route costs more than honest mining earns.
